blurb: B.A.C. Helicopters offers helicopter flight training for Private, Commercial, and CFI ratings with flexible scheduling and ground instruction. They also provide scenic helicopter tours ranging from 30 minutes to 1 hour over local landmarks and regions. The company maintains aircraft and offers repair services including inspections and modifications.
